sources.summary: FROM FRAGMENTS TO AN URBAN FRAMEWORK YARD is pleased to announce INTO THE FRAME, an intensive urban design workshop in Yerevan led by architect and urbanist Kees Christiaanse. The workshop explores how fragmented urban territories can be connected, transformed, and reimagined as part of a larger urban framework. THE WORKSHOP 25-30 participants will work in small groups across a selected fragment of Yerevan, continuously relating their ideas to a shared physical model at 1:1000 or 1:500 scale.
